identity.real_world_identity_notes: McLaren 720S GT3 of 2019, running a race-prepared version of the McLaren M840T 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 through a six-speed sequential paddle gearbox with an electronic shift actuator. It is the model that preceded the 720S GT3 Evo, which AMS2 curates separately in its own class.

wheel_rim.notes: Observed from the cockpit during the guided drive.

notes: Simulator behaviour was directly observed in a guided drive in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with automatic clutch and shifting disabled: clutch-free move-off, automatic cut on upshifts and automatic blip on downshifts, so the driver supplies none of the three.

This is a different car from the curated McLaren 720S GT3 Evo. AMS2 places this one in the GT3 class and the Evo in GT3_Gen2, and nothing is inherited between them even though both are six-speed paddle cars.
Only the plain identity has been observed for this car and its class has reported no aero package, so no further identity is carried.
Observed live in AMS2 1.6.9.91 via guided verification observation ams2.mclaren-720s-gt3.20260816t000803309z-39c312fd by Jason Kinslow.

confidence.basis: Simulator behaviour was live-tested in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with automatic clutch and shifting disabled, and the real-world transmission is supported by a registered source.

claims.basis: A registered source establishes the 2019 720S GT3 and its gearbox, and the exact simulator identity was observed live.
The source gives a six-speed sequential paddle gearbox, and the live drive selected six paddle gears with automatic cut and blip and no clutch needed to pull away.
Directly observed during the guided drive: move-off, shift clutch use, automatic cut and blip, and the cockpit rim.

notes: The wheel-rim shape was originally recorded as "gt-style". The separate "gt-style", "formula" and "prototype" values described the same rim: molded grips at 9 and 3 with a control face between them, usually carrying a display and rev lights. They are merged into "gt-formula". The rim was not observed again and nothing about the observation changed.
